notes: Thirty-two-function unit 0x021443f4..0x021458d4: D1 and D0 from the out-of-line destructor, the twenty-four helpers func_ov100_02144468..func_ov100_021453d8, CleanupResources, OnPendingDestroy, Render, Behavior, InitResources, and the folded registry factory daDoor_c_classInit as `return new daDoor_c;`.
Written in ROM order under `#pragma defer_codegen off`, which keeps D1 ahead of D0. None of the legacy shards carried a pragma.

The per-shard extern blocks are merged into one declaration per callee. Where shards disagreed (func_ov100_021453d8's argument types, the int/void* return of func_ov100_02145370, data_0209caa0 as bytes, words or a three-word struct, data_ov100_02148204 as bytes or a 16-byte entry) the TU keeps one spelling and casts at the call sites; every caller reproduces with it. The nine state tables are declared as the int include/decl_common.h gives two of them, and the helpers' Player calls are member calls through include/Player.h.

Eighteen of the helpers, InitResources and the factory were C sources; they compile as C++ here. Their stack and static vectors are a plain three-word struct so they carry no destructor, and InitResources copies the door matrix into both models through a twelve-word array struct (the struct-copy lever of notes/cpp-class-form.md).

InitResources is now the real daDoor_c::InitResources method rather than a C free function taking the object explicitly; the redundant (u32) cast on the param1 shift is still what keeps the offset folded into both accesses.

Fourteen helpers (func_ov100_02144468..func_ov100_02144cf8) are the enter/execute members of the door's nine states: pointer-to-member constants at ov100 0x021480d4..0x02148144, copied by the module's static initializer into the 16-byte tables data_ov100_021488a4..data_ov100_02148924. func_ov100_021453d8 stores a state at +0x140 and calls its enter half; Behavior calls the execute half.

compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. One out-of-line destructor under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1, D0, then D2. The cartridge has D1 at ov100:0x021443f4 and D0 at 0x02144424 and no D2. Production isolation discards it. It is emitted after D0, and the licensed functions stay ROM-ascending.

The out-of-line destructor is the key function, so this TU emits the vtable. ov100:0x02148188 is in .data, outside the licensed text span 0x021443f4..0x021458d4. D1, D0 and the factory store this vptr; text-only production discards the emitted copy and retains cartridge data.
This class's __si_class_type_info, dragged in with the vtable. Cartridge copy ov100:0x02148158. Its base word is _ZTI8dActor_c.
